recommended.intent: Best balance of image quality, playability and stability for normal TV play.
notes: Starts from Encore Recommended and raises only internal resolution from 1.0x to 1.25x.
At a 1080p-class docked source, 1.25x is approximately 2400x1350, already close to 2560x1440 output.
Bilinear keeps the scaling path light because only a small final resize remains.
FXAA is retained from Encore Recommended as the low-cost anti-aliasing choice.
FSR sharpness is stored at Encore's 50% default but is inactive while Bilinear is selected.

smooth.intent: Maximum frame-time headroom without lowering the source game's native-class rendering scale.
notes: Keeps the game at 1.0x while matching the documented 1080p-class docked baseline of the Frostbite FC Switch line.
1080p output removes unnecessary presentation scaling cost.
No extra post-process AA is added, preserving GPU headroom and image clarity.

performance.intent: Maximum practical GPU headroom while preserving a usable 1080p TV image.
notes: 0.75x cuts internal pixel workload to 56.25% of 1.0x.
FSR is appropriate here because the lower-resolution image must be reconstructed to 1080p output.
40% sharpness is intentionally moderate to recover detail without making FSR sharpening the dominant image characteristic.
No additional FXAA/SMAA is layered after FSR.

design_rules: Preserve the game's 30 FPS target instead of attempting to force 60 FPS.
Use Docked mode for TV profiles so the game exposes its higher source-console rendering mode.
Use 60 Hz output for exact 2:1 presentation cadence at 30 FPS.
Prefer native or near-output internal resolution before introducing reconstruction.
Use FSR only when the internal scale is deliberately reduced below 1.0x.
Profiles are hardware-derived baselines and are applied without a validation gate.
